publication.recovered_objective: Persist repository work records and reconnect future chats

scope: Fresh checkout registration/recovery without original runs
Agent-facing English / Korean user report separation (focused code and guide review)

findings.title: Same-status content edits were not detected
findings.before: Changing an already untracked/modified file could leave git_changed=false because porcelain status was unchanged.
findings.fix: SHA-256 fingerprint over tracked and nonignored untracked content, with names/type/deletion/link markers; self-written .agent-work excluded. Index object IDs and modes are included to detect staged-only changes with unchanged worktree and porcelain status.
findings.verification: Independent original repro changed from after_content_change=false to true; 7 repository-memory tests passed.

verification.command: Bundled Python unittest loader: test_repoctl, isolated temp root in approved workspace

verification.method: Copy Git-portable .agent-work records to a separate initialized checkout; register using a fresh local registry without old runs; load saved task; create separate bound follow-up

verification.reason: Local git clone was blocked by sandbox Git sh.exe NtCreateDirectoryObject access denial. Relocation and new-process resume were verified; no actual clone success is claimed.

limitations: Review does not certify future agent compliance or host-enforced isolation.
Historical artifacts/evidence paths are not copied by repoctl; the guide requires re-verifying missing evidence in a new checkout.
Fingerprint covers root repository Git-visible files; it does not certify nested submodule directory contents as unchanged.
Remote publication and GitHub commit ancestry are handled by the main session and were not performed by this evaluator.
notes: No author product files were changed by evaluator.
No further blocking defect was found in the reviewed scope.
Existing run/task collision checks and immutable historical records are preserved; fresh checkout continuation uses a new task ID.
Final staged-only delta independently reviewed; latest 7-test regression suite rerun passed.
